WITH perRaceStats AS (
  SELECT 
    cr.raceId,
    r.name as raceName,
    AVG(cr.points) as perRaceAvg,
    COUNT(*) as resultCount
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY cr.raceId, r.name
),
raceNameStats AS (
  SELECT 
    raceName,
    AVG(perRaceAvg) as raceNameAvg
  FROM perRaceStats
  GROUP BY raceName
)
SELECT 
  prs.raceId,
  prs.raceName,
  prs.perRaceAvg,
  prs.resultCount,
  CASE 
    WHEN rns.raceNameAvg > 0 THEN prs.perRaceAvg / rns.raceNameAvg
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM perRaceStats prs
INNER JOIN raceNameStats rns ON prs.raceName = rns.raceName
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
